title: observability: propagate request IDs and traces across streaming/openai-compat API surface; add per-endpoint metrics tags
author: Priya Singh
description: Motivation: Customers asked for end-to-end observability on the API surface (hosted + openai-compat endpoints) so that request correlation, trace debugging, and per-endpoint cost/latency breakdowns work reliably for streaming, function/tool-calling, and structured output flows. This PR implements: 1) propagation of request IDs (x-request-id / internal request_id) from edge -> gateway -> runtime -> workers and ensures they are present on streaming events (SSE/Chunked frames) and structured tool-calls; 2) W3C traceparent propagation and lightweight span metadata attachment in logs so traces can be correlated with existing tracing backends; 3) JSON-structured logs standardization to always include request_id, trace_id, span_id, endpoint, model, and route tags; 4) per-endpoint metrics tags by adding endpoint and compatibility-mode labels to token/latency counters so dashboards and per-route SLOs can be computed. Summary of changes: - gateway/handlers/streaming_handler.go: attach request_id to stream frames, ensure stream generator includes trace_id in initial 'meta' event. - openai_compat/handler.go: map incoming OpenAI 'X-Request-Id' to internal request_id and support both header and query token cases; preserve semantics for existing compatibility behavior. - runtime/tracing/tracer.go + runtime/tracing/context.go: add tracer wrapper that extracts/injects W3C traceparent and emits minimal span metadata for logs. - observability/metrics/endpoint_tags.go: add functions to tag metrics with endpoint and compat_mode (openai|redwood) and update registration. - logging/json_logger.go: ensure all API entrypoints log structured JSON with request_id/trace; add helper to include span and endpoint tags. - tests/e2e/observability_streaming_test.py: end-to-end test that asserts request_id and trace propagation through streaming SSE frames and function-call events. Checklist: - [x] Propagate request_id for non-streaming flows - [x] Propagate request_id and trace for streaming flows - [x] Ensure structured logs include request_id/trace/endpoint/model - [x] Add per-endpoint metrics tags and update dashboards (dashboard change in separate PR) - [x] Add e2e integration tests and unit tests - [x] Manual validation on staging (smoke tests) Testing & Validation: added unit tests for tracer extraction/injection and logger formatting; added e2e test that runs a streaming generation with a downstream tool-call to validate tool/function calling still includes request_id on sub-events. Ran smoke tests on staging and validated Grafana dashboards receive tagged metrics. Backwards compatibility: OpenAI compatibility behavior unchanged for payloads; any incoming X-Request-Id header is honored and mapped to internal request_id. Rollout: feature gated behind runtime flag `obs.api_propagation_v1` and enabled progressively on hosted staging then production. Follow-ups: - dashboard PR to rename a handful of panels to use new endpoint tag (ENG-4298) - add support for sampling config for traces when volume is high - add docs for SDKs showing how to pass/receive request_id in streaming clients

review_comments: Evan Park: Can we avoid changing the public event schema for streaming clients? We should add the request_id in a non-breaking meta event rather than mutate the canonical payload.
Priya Singh (author): Agree; added an initial 'meta' event that is emitted before any token/data frames. This keeps existing consumers working and gives a stable place to read request and trace info.
Luis Gomez: Linter complained about log formatting in logging/json_logger.go; also please add unit test that asserts header precedence (X-Request-Id vs generated).
Priya Singh (author): Addressed lint issue and added header-precedence unit test. CI was re-run after fixes.
Anya Patel: Approve after nit: add a small note in openai_compat/README about header mapping so third-party tools know X-Request-Id will be respected.
Priya Singh (author): Added README note and small code comment referencing compatibility.

release_notes: Added end-to-end request_id and trace propagation for API surface including streaming and OpenAI-compat endpoints. Structured logs now include request_id/trace_id/span_id/endpoint/model. Metrics now include per-endpoint tags to enable per-route SLOs and dashboards. Backwards compatible; gated rollout.
